lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: At a genuine 390x844 viewport the trace detail is 408px wide, and at 320x800 it remains 408px wide; every detail card extends beyond the viewport.
findings.evidence: 04-mobile-trace.jpg and 06-mobile-320-trace-top.jpg; runtime metrics recorded innerWidth/bodyScrollWidth as 390/408 and 320/408, with detail-card right edges at x=408.
findings.user_impact: Diagnostic labels, model names, evidence, and receipt content are cropped or require two-dimensional scrolling, making the mobile result materially harder to read and failing the intended narrow-screen reflow.
findings.recommendation: Remove the detail layout min-content floor with min-width:0 and width/box-sizing constraints on the grid and cards, then test long identifiers and raw attributes at 390px, 320px, and 200% zoom.
findings.verification: bodyScrollWidth equals innerWidth at both viewports, all result content is reachable by vertical scrolling only, and no focused control is obscured by navigation.

findings.observation: One eight-span run produces a 5903px mobile page where nine passing mechanics, the tool ledger, every raw span, artifacts, and events are expanded by default while the one needs-review item has no jump target.
findings.evidence: 04-mobile-trace.jpg and its measured 5903px document height show semantic_outcome_quality surrounded by expanded passing checks and raw diagnostic cards.
findings.user_impact: A tester must scan and scroll through mechanics to find the single judgment that needs attention, increasing triage time and the chance that the review requirement is missed.
findings.recommendation: Make failed and needs-review checks the default expanded summary; collapse passing checks and raw spans, with anchors to receipt, evaluations, tools, artifacts, and events.
findings.verification: The first failed or needs-review item and its supporting artifact or tool are reachable in three taps or focus moves while the complete raw receipt remains available.

strengths: The genuine 390px entry reflows the form into a clear single column with explicit labels and a full-width primary action.
Statuses use text as well as color, and the DOM preserves headings, links, controls, and artifact alt text.
The product truthfully labels synthetic-only scope, zero external effects, and lack of visual interpretation.
missing_evidence: No screen-reader, keyboard-only, 200% zoom, localization-expansion, dark-mode, reduced-motion, or failure-recovery run.
No narrow-screen retest after correcting the 408px min-content floor.
open_questions: Should the developer-oriented trace ledger be a separate progressive-disclosure layer rather than the default mobile result?
